title: cyclosorus sessilipinnus
intro: Cyclosorus sessilipinnus, commonly known as the small-pinnate cyclosorus fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Cyclosorus sessilipinnus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as wound healing, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer properties. The plant is also used to treat fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties.
